title: MettleUp's notices in the bell vanish exactly when the server is over its limit
what: The bell asks for MettleUp's notices every 15 minutes and on every Refresh. When that ask fails, for example because the shared daily request limit is used up, the answer is treated as 'no notices' and the notices already on screen are wiped. So a notice like 'we are having trouble today, please wait' disappears from every gym at the very moment it is needed, with no sign that anything failed.
expected: A failed ask keeps the last notices on screen, and the owner can tell MettleUp's messages could not be reached.
how_often: whenever the server is over a limit or down
fix_line: Keep the last notices when the read fails instead of treating a failure as an empty list

items.reason: Paid or capped things reached from this area: Cloudflare daily requests (HQ news every 15 minutes while visible, Refresh, gym state and logo reads; the minute Needs-you poll is the big one, already a finding), Supabase database size (device-alert subscriptions table), browser storage for the offline desk (already findings), Razorpay fees on Pay MettleUp (hidden). The member card and growth report are drawn in the browser; the clock tick in Refresh is local only. No AI or WhatsApp template call in this area.
At the request or server limit the Refresh button shows a failed state; the HQ notices are wiped silently; the stopped-paying line just does not show; logo reads fall back to a plain card.
Nothing in this area warns before a limit; the request-limit warning gap is already recorded for HQ.
